pool.text: Cecil John Rhodes picked Gaberones to house a colonial fort for the territory.
The modern town of Gaborone was founded after a decision to establish a capital.
The capital of the Bechuanaland Protectorate moved from Mafeking to Gaberones.
Bechuanaland became the eleventh British dependency in Africa to become an independent republic.
The museum officially opened to the public in the growing city of Gaborone.
The Botswana Red Cross Society was established and headquartered in the city of Gaborone.
The city officially changed its name from Gaberones to Gaborone.
The Gaborone Town Council and Ministry surveyed Bontleng to contain low-income housing.
The Botswana Housing Corporation built a New Naledi across the road from Old Naledi.
President Sir Seretse Khama rezoned Naledi from an industrial zone to low-income housing.
The Southern African Development Community was formed with its headquarters located in Gaborone.
The annual Maitisong Festival started and is held every year for seven days.
The reserve was built and became the third-busiest in the country of Botswana.
Riots started in Gaborone following the general elections because of high unemployment and issues.
The Mokolodi Nature Reserve was created as a thirty-square-kilometre reserve near the city.
The Cancer Association of Botswana was established as a voluntary non-governmental trust.
An International Law Enforcement Academy was established in Gaborone.
The museum opened a botanical garden called the National Botanical Garden in Gaborone.
The park was officially opened by the Botswana Minister of Environment, Wildlife and Tourism.
The railway line became a cargo-only line before passenger services resumed later.
